verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an account-based API service that records sales, attributes users and manages price-tracking subscriptions, so exporting a user's own data is a fair question for it. However, no evidence documents any account data export or portability feature. The CLI's output-format selection applies to API query responses, not to exporting the user's data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
